preserves: Version 0.1.0 remains frozen as the Case 1 exact-page contract.
extension_summary: separates an official RFP page constraint from a later planning target
represents an RFP with no total-page limit without inventing one
makes the A3 counting multiplier nullable when the RFP does not define it
records conflicts among the official TOC, detailed writing guide, requirements, and evaluation table
keeps generation available while page allocation and RPA release remain HOLD

page_modes.RFP_EXACT: rfp_target_pages is required and exact allocation is enforced
page_modes.RFP_UNSPECIFIED: rfp_target_pages is null and generation may proceed without page allocation

operations: place detailed obligations below the applicable official parent
assign exactly one MAIN mapping per proposal-body obligation
record source conflicts without silently changing the official hierarchy
emit workbook and RPA specification in HOLD when a required planning target is absent

reimport_contract.new_row_rule: Unknown or blank node_id is NEW and receives a provisional stable identifier.
reimport_contract.regeneration_rule: No TOC or RPA specification is regenerated without an explicit human command.

invariants.official_structure: An RFP-fixed parent and level cannot change; title may change.
invariants.level_limit: Levels 1 through 3 are routine; level 4 requires review.
invariants.main_rule: Each non-control atomic obligation has exactly one MAIN mapping.
invariants.consortium_rule: An RFP prohibition overrides a consortium declaration and produces HOLD.
invariants.unspecified_page_rule: RFP_UNSPECIFIED never creates an inferred official target.
invariants.planning_completion_rule: For RFP_UNSPECIFIED, allocation can complete only after an explicit planning target exists, assigned pages equal it, both checks pass, and conflicts are cleared.
invariants.a3_rule: A3 changes are always detected; counted-page multiplication occurs only when a case-specific multiplier is authoritative.
invariants.release_rule: RPA release always requires an explicit human release command.

non_goals: automatic regeneration after every external input
reopening_conditions: Case 3 cannot be represented without semantic loss
a planning target is mistaken for an RFP constraint
an undefined A3 multiplier is silently treated as two
a source conflict is lost during generation or re-import
